x: All four Labour Codes, including the Code on Social Security, came into force on 21 November 2025, with Central Rules following in 2026. 17 April 2026 and 8 May 2026 are not the commencement date, and 2019 predates the 2020 Code.

Statements 1 and 3 are correct: the IB is now headed by Mahesh Dixit, an AP-cadre (1993 IPS) officer, and RAW (1968) is India's external intelligence agency. Statement 2 is wrong: the IB (1887) handles internal intelligence under the MHA; it is RAW that sits under the Cabinet Secretariat. So 1 and 3 only (B).

All three statements are correct: the Jal Jeevan Mission was launched in 2019 under the Ministry of Jal Shakti to give a Functional Household Tap Connection to every rural home, and Village Water and Sanitation Committees plan and run the supply. So 1, 2 and 3 (D).

All four statements are correct: NSAP (1995) is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme of the Ministry of Rural Development for BPL households, giving effect to Article 41, and about 94% of its payments are made by DBT. So 1, 2, 3 and 4 (D).

e-Shram (26 Aug 2021, MoLE) is the Aadhaar-verified National Database of Unorganised Workers, open to those aged 16-59, so it covers unorganised workers such as gig, migrant and agricultural workers. It excludes income-tax payers and EPFO/ESIC members, so options about organised-sector, government or EPFO workers are wrong.
